decisive_finding.cause: The WorkerResult names a different actor from the actual dispatched agent. validate_for passed only because the reconstructed LeaseSpec copied the packet's incorrect worker value, so it did not bind evidence to the root-dispatched principal.
decisive_finding.false_pass: A self-reconstructed lease cannot establish dispatch provenance when its owner is derived from the untrusted result under validation.

corrective_action: The same dispatched agent may replace only its WorkerResult file, name its canonical runtime agent exactly, reconstruct the lease from the durable root dispatch rather than from the packet, revalidate the unchanged 20-artifact set, and emit a new external result ID. Independent review remains required.
claim_ceiling: The HCT-OBSERVE bytes remain an unaccepted source candidate. Public wiring, CLI/product behavior, export runtime, node closure, readiness, release, and completion remain withheld.
no_claim_statement: This decision rejects result provenance only and raises no product or completion claim.
